task.title: Setting up a controller under the Supervisor’s network in the Supervisor station
task.shortdesc: For the data in a controller station’s database to be shared with the Supervisor station and beyond, the unique properties that configure a controller must be present as a node under the Supervisor’s BACnet network. While you may discover the controller stations, add each controller configuration as a New AWS or OWS device, or drag a BacnetAwsDevice or BacnetOwsDevice from the appropriate palette to the BACnet network node in the Supervisor station, this procedure documents using the New button on the Bacnet Aws Device Manager.

taskbody.prereq: You are using running in a PC and connected to the Supervisor station.

step.stepresult: The Bacnet Aws Device Manager opens.

step.cmd: Add one or more BACnet AWS devices and click OK.
Name each device and configure the Device ID, Netwk and MAC Addr (IP address) for each, then click OK.
step.info: As a best practice, consider naming devices for the controller IP addresses. You don’t have to use the entire address, just the last two or three digits.
step.stepresult: The driver creates a controller network record for each controller under the Supervisor station’s BacnetAwsNetwork.
